description: Numbers behind the guidance verdicts and the may-be-incomplete warning (#27, #53). The B Night canvas drew the verdict lines as placeholders and no decision settles them yet, so they are provisional.

well_under_below.source: B Night canvas, B_Today weekly card: below 75% of target reads Well under.

on_target_low.source: B Night canvas, B_Today weekly card: from 90% of target reads On target.

on_target_high.source: B Night canvas, B_Today weekly card: up to 110% of target reads On target.

incomplete_min_entries.source: Chosen for this build. B_DayEnd only says few entries.

incomplete_ended_before_minute.source: Chosen for this build: nothing logged from 16:00 on. B_DayEnd shows a day that stops at 13:10.

incomplete_gap_minutes.source: Chosen for this build: 8 hours between two entries. B_DayEnd only says a long gap.

suggestion_limit.source: docs/MVP.md: 3 suggestions that fit the gap.

weekday_over_high.source: D Night canvas, D_Trends weekday pattern: a weekday above 105% of target is drawn in the lighter orange.

partial_day_below.source: Decision 47 (Max, 2026-11-14): a logged day whose known calories are under half the calorie target looks partly logged and is left out of averages, unless the user counts it.
